text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~... So this is the Fan Appreciation Festival...!
I've seen it on TV, but it sure is lively in person...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I'm actually here, this place is amazin'~!!
...And, uh..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me.
Welcome, everyone. Thank you all for coming.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided on your destination?
I would be delighted to show you the way, so please don't hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that'd be a huge help~!!
So, y'see, I'm tryin' to get to this classroom—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President, thank you for guiding the guests.
Even so... it seems quite a lot of elderly visitors have come this year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true.
And it seems everyone—shares the same destination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
Believe had signed up for two events, the first
of which was a handshake event currently underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a very simple event—
just "shake hands, chat a little"—and yet...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, you ready?
...My, Believe-chan, it's been such a long time~!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the person from the bus...
It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I was watchin' the Kitakyushu Kinen! Though it's been a while since I've been to Kokura.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: Aww, I'm totally a fan now! Believe-chan is so fast~~! Working so hard, she's so amazing~~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, thank you very much.
For coming all this way."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Mornings and evenings are still quite chilly...
Please take good care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: Awwwww... What a good, sweet baby you areeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer.
Sorry to bug ya while you're busy.
Got a sec for a question?"
choice_data_list: Yes, what can I help you with?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
"I brought some loquats we picked at home
as a treat, but... is it alright to hand these over?"
choice_data_list: Yes, that's fine! Please put it on the shelf over there.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text:
You can hand it over! Ah~ that's grand, then!
It tastes way better chilled, ya know,
so you should eat some together with your Trainer, too.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We can give presents?
Maybe I should go buy something right now...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
No, please don't push yourself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Sprint Queen who conquered both spring and autumn.
Believe's meet-and-greet remained peaceful throughout, yet drew a massive, lively crowd...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Sprint Queen who conquered both spring and autumn.
Believe's meet-and-greet was calm and peaceful, yet bustling with energy, until—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
How long is the line right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, the line was already trailing out into the hallway.
Hurrying to check where the end of the line was—
choice_data_list: Th-there are like 50 people lined up...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the line keeps getting longer!
At this rate, it looks like it'll take quite a while to get through everyone...
choice_data_list: Sorry, are you starting to get tired by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, it's not me...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to step away for a bit.
Trainer, will you—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Please let the person
waiting in line inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where did Believe go, and what did she go to do? Without knowing the answer, I went ahead and invited the fans inside as told.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after waiting for a while...

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
My, my, all the way from Kyushu!
Is that right—... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Down the hallway... there's a shadow that looks like a tower, ain't there?
What the heck is that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*thud!!*)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting.
I brought some folding chairs, so I'll set them up now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Please come inside, everyone.
Take a seat and wait.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: For handshakes, I'll go around the seats myself.
choice_data_list: (Ah... I see, she was worrying about my legs and lower back...!)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Believe-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, we will now resume the handshake event.
Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, overflowing with her signature warm consideration, the meet-and-greet concluded as a roaring success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, changing scenes to the track ground.
The second event Believe is participating in is—
A standard rules race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"True to her style, she had entered a 1,200m race
where she could show her usual steady, reliable running,
but..."

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: “—400 meters remaining! And Believe takes the lead! The sprint queen who conquered both spring and autumn takes the lead right here!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Believe is in the lead! Believe takes the lead!
The other Umamusume pick up the pace, but she holds on stubbornly!
Still in the lead, it's Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Whittling away at them and holding on through sheer grit.
The craft she's honed to perfection truly shines here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is how I've seen it through.
This is how I've kept on winning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Until this moment.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: !! Tearing through the pack comes Durandal! Durandal is closing in on the leader, Believe, with tremendous momentum!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: YaaaaaaaAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Here comes Durandal! Here comes Durandal!!
The lead changes hands here—it's Durandal!!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line! In first place is Durandal!!
Successfully striking down Queen Believe
is the knight of thunderous strides, Durandal!!”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
That closing kick's sharpness is truly that of a holy sword!!
At the Spring Fan Thanksgiving 1200m race,
Durandal delivers a glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the cheers erupting right beside me sound distant,
as I just... stand there, frozen.
That's just how shocking the sight before me was.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—For there is naught that cannot be severed
by the holy sword residing within me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had indeed said so in the past.
Therefore, I too had recognized that sharpness
was the true essence of her speed.
choice_data_list: (Still... but what she just showed me was—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is simply—too far detached from reason.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"—Now then, since we have the winner Durandal here with us,
let's hear about your future outlook!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san!
Could you say a few words
for all of your fans?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
—Everyone, thank you so much for your cheers today.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I was plagued by injury,
and sharpening my blade took time—
but the preparations for battle are complete.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My next race is the Centaur Stakes.
And after that—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
At this year's Sprinters Stakes, the holy sword shall shine without a cloud of doubt.
âHere and now, I swear to bring you victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooohhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "The Sprinters Stakes... Not just Light O-san, but Durandal-san too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume striving for the absolute peak of 'speed'
had finally gathered in one place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Sprinters Stakes—the moment of truth—drawing near,
a massive, overwhelming swell was about to crash down on Believe...
